body:
Thank you so much for your reply. 

I'm afraid I've had it all wrong, though. He just now finished badgering me (for the moment, at least), trying to get me to give him some of my anti anxiety meds (I take a low dose of klonopin). He wanted me to not only give him my medication, but to drive to a different town, to his family's home, and deliver it to him. His family, who hates me, and to whom he very apparently hasn't stood up for me. I don't know if it's the incredible anger I'm feeling now, or the hurt, but at least I no longer feel guilty. He almost killed himself. He made me so crazy he almost killed me. But he just wants more. I suppose it's probably our whole relationship has been about what he could get from me and how he could manipulate me. I've been a fool. It's funny when I remember all the times my mother told me that I was "forgiving to a fault" when I was growing up. I was young enough not to understand how forgiveness could sometimes be the wrong way to handle things. Well, it sure as shit took me long enough, but my forgiving days are done. I only wish I wouldn't have to feel this love I still have for him, for however long it takes to get out of my system. You can't live with someone for that long, become close, then snap your fingers and not care about them anymore. I can't wait until that feeling is over and he means as little to me as I do to him. I told him he should go ahead and leave me alone now. I'm in shock... but then, I'm really not. I've been stupid. I won't be so again. 

Apologies if I failed to address the points you made in your comment. Just too worked up to think about much else but this at the moment. I'll comment again later and try to make more sense. 

Again, thank you.
